issue.title: Push pending offline claims before the reconnect upload and the chapter-list refresh [Offline chapter assignment Audit]
issue.body:
Found during the offline chapter assignment audit (#533, epic #526).

**Severity:** High  
**Launch blocker:** To be decided with product  
**Confirmed on:** Xiaomi Redmi Note 9 Pro, Android 10 (API 29), local debug build of `main` @ `fb634e5`, `dev.api.fluent.bible` (scenarios C.1–C.3, D.3, F-alt)

## Summary

Only the full sync (`syncAllUsers` / `syncAllData`: Sync Now, login, reauth, Home auto-repair) pushes pending offline claims (`src/services/sync.ts:301`). The other online paths act without them:

- **Automatic upload on reconnect or app open** (`src/services/uploadOrchestratorCore.ts:245`): the server still sees the chapter as unassigned `not_started`, the edit policy rejects the upload, and the take is marked failed with a misleading 404 "Verse audio recording not found".
- **Sync Now** (`src/app/screens/SyncScreen.tsx:94-96`) starts the full sync without awaiting it and runs the upload in parallel. The full sync spends about 30 s on master data before the claims, so the upload loses the race every time and the take uploads only in a later session.
- **Chapter-list refresh** (`refreshChapterMetadataIfOnline`, `src/services/sync.ts:1142`) → `reconcileUserChapterWork` (`src/db/repository.ts:1341`) clears the local assignee for chapters the server did not return, ignoring `chapter_claim_queue`, so the provisional "mine" disappears until a full sync.
- **Sync page:** after a failed upload, Sync Now stays disabled until the page is reopened. With no pending uploads, Sync Now is hidden (`src/components/ui/SyncActionControls.tsx:147-150`) even while claims are pending or the chapter-claims error is shown, so the only way to push a claim is to sign out and back in.

In a conflict, this delay also uses up the 5-minute window #610 depends on (D.3 passed only because Sync Now was tapped in time).

## Expected

Per #271, claims sync "as part of the standard sync cycle" on reconnect. The row stays "mine", and takes on an offline-claimed chapter upload without errors.

## Actual

Upload 404 before the claim push (C.1, C.3); provisional "mine" cleared by the list refresh (C.2); no UI to push claims when no uploads are pending (F-alt).

## Steps to reproduce

1. Offline: record on an unassigned chapter (it shows "mine").
2. Turn Wi-Fi on and wait, without tapping Sync Now: the upload fails.
3. Open Projects → the project: the row is no longer "mine".
4. Sync → Sync Now: the upload fails again, the claim is pushed about 30 s later, and the take uploads only on a later session.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Every online path that talks to the server for a chapter (automatic upload session, Sync Now upload, chapter-list refresh) pushes pending claims first, or waits for them.
- [ ] The list refresh does not clear a local assignee that has a pending claim.
- [ ] No upload error for takes on an offline-claimed chapter after reconnect.
- [ ] The Sync page offers a way to push pending claims (and retry after a failed upload) without signing out.
- [ ] Unit tests: ordering (claims before upload); reconcile keeps pending claims.
- [ ] Android device QA: steps above.

## Related

- Parent audit: #533 (epic #526)
- #271, #545, #273, #530 (Returning online audit)
- Same behavior confirmed by the #530 audit (Gap 9); its device evidence is on #271: https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/issues/271#issuecomment-5874706180
- #610, #612 (master data delay drives the race)
- Assessment: `docs/assessments/offline-chapter-assignment/README.md` (PR #609)
